raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.35.3"
  maturin_min: "1.5"
  maturin_max: "2.0"
  cargo_wrapper: cargo-auditable-wrapper.${{ "bat" if win else "sh" }}
  python_check_max: "3.14"
  all_test_skips: |-
    not-a-test
    export_report_diagnostics
  # appear to fail due to path assumptions
  win_test_skips: |-
    changed_files_new_branch
    changed_files_working_directory
    distributed_config_example_dir
    layers_explicit_depends_on
    many_features_example_dir
    monorepo_workspace_example_dir_external
    source_change_runs_dependent_tests
    test_file_change_runs_that_file
    valid_example_dir_monorepo
  test_skips: ${{ (all_test_skips ~ ((" " ~ win_test_skips) if win else "")) | split | join(" or ") }}

package:
  name: tach
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/t/tach/tach-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 251a9cbbadd923f54668ca5f1adc4d5239ccab87fd630c5880efced235175661

build:
  number: 0
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
    entry_points:
      - tach = tach.start:start
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
      CARGO: ${{ cargo_wrapper }}
      PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8
      PYTHONLEGACYTEXTENCODING: utf-8
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          # for `path too long` errors from e.g. `ruff_linter`
          - git config --system core.longpaths true
          - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\${{ cargo_wrapper }}" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin"
        else:
          - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/${{ cargo_wrapper }}" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/"
          - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/${{ cargo_wrapper }}"
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check --check-build-dependencies
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cargo-auditable
    - git
  host:
    - maturin >=${{ maturin_min }},<${{ maturin_max }}
    - pip
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - python-abi3
  run:
    - gitpython >=3.1,<4.0
    - networkx >=2.6,<4.0
    - prompt-toolkit >=3.0,<4.0
    - pydot >=2,<5
    - python
    - pyyaml >=6.0,<7.0
    - rich >=13.0
    - tomli >=1.2.2
    - tomli-w >=1.0,<2.0
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - python-abi3

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - if: not is_abi3
          then:
            - tach
            - if: win
              then:
                - tach-script.py
      files:
        - etc/conda/test-files/tach/**
      site_packages:
        - tach/**
        - tach-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
  - python:
      imports: tach
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
          else:
            - "*"
  - files:
      source:
        - python/tests/**
        - Cargo.toml
        - pyproject.toml
    requirements:
      run:
        # - coverage
        - pytest
        - pytest-mock
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - abi3audit
            - python !=${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - tach --help
      - tach --version
      - tach --version | python -c "import sys; assert '${{ version }}' in sys.stdin.read()"
      # fails with circular import of `logging` (maybe because `tach.logging`?)
      # - coverage run --source=tach --branch pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes -k "not export_report_diagnostics"
      # - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered --fail-under=47
      - pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes -k "not (${{ test_skips }})"
      - if: is_abi3
        then:
          - cd "${{ "${SP_DIR}" if unix else "%SP_DIR%" }}/tach"
          - abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} extension.${{ "abi3.so" if unix else "pyd" }}

about:
  summary: A Python tool to maintain a modular package architecture.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/tach
  repository: https://github.com/tach-org/tach
  documentation: https://docs.gauge.sh

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
